fields.description: Issue dated October 6, 1928, featuring editorials and satirical news items on Miami-area civic affairs and politics, including discussion of hurricane history and expectations, tourism and seasonal business conditions, municipal controversies in Coral Gables and Hialeah, and commentary on flood control and wildlife protection along the Tamiami Trail/Everglades. Includes sports notes, local entertainment listings, and extensive advertising.
